utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Dane — I’m glad to help with the repair drive. What’s the first thing you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mara, thanks — I’m running a bit late as usual. Could you help me sort the tools and make a quick list of what still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can sort the tools and make a quick list of what still needs fixing. I’ll get started now and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo. I’ll check the list and send you the exact items we still need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect — send it over when you have it, and I’ll grab what I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a little list going for the repair drive—what supplies do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think we still need tape and a few screwdrivers, maybe some gloves too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it — I’ll add tape, screwdrivers, and gloves to the list. If you think of anything else, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help a bit with the repair drive—what do you need most?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — I’m mostly worried about how we’ll move everything and keep track of the bigger items.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help label the bigger items and keep a list as we load them. If you want, I can also help carry a few of the heavier things.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you want me to bring anything for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, if you’ve got extra tape or gloves, that’d be great—I heard those always run out fast.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I can bring tape and a pair of gloves.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive’s picking up nicely—folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you’re heading over, I’d go soon before the good stuff runs out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m heading over now—can’t let all the good tools disappear before I get there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Good call—if you spot any extra screwdrivers, grab one for me too!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive this afternoon—want me to put your name down?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please put me down — I can help over by the community center after 3.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve got you down for the community center after 3. Thanks, Opal!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Sam — can you confirm you’re still available to help with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m still available to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo, I’m getting the repair drive organized and I can use a hand. What would you like to help with first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can help sort the donated tools first, if that works.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That works perfectly, Bo — thank you. I’ll set out the donated tools and labels, and we can sort them together.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m telling folks we’re meeting at the repair drive this Saturday, and I’ll remind everyone again tomorrow. If you can help, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Vik — I like having the plan set. I can help Saturday; just send me the time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll send you the time tomorrow and I’ll mention the Saturday repair drive again to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m a bit scattered today, but I’m happy to help. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just your screwdriver set, if you can. And maybe a flashlight, if you have one.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I can bring both — screwdriver set and a flashlight. I’ll grab them before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad you brought it up — the repair drive is a really good way to get everyone helping together. What part do you want to tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can start by checking which repairs are most urgent and what supplies we already have. Then I’ll swing by the bulletin board and see who’s available to help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds perfect — I can help match people with the jobs that fit their skills once you know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, we’re putting together the repair drive—can you swing by and help spread the word? It’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I can swing by later and help spread the word. Just tell me when and where.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome—thanks, Dane. Come by the community center around 5, and I’ll fill you in there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that repair drive—what still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. Could you check the porch light, the loose gate latch, and the leaky faucet in the kitchen?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can check those. I’ll start with the porch light and gate latch, then take a look at the faucet.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate it around the school pickup window, so we don’t end up short on volunteers. What time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be great, Faye — thank you. I’m thinking we could start around 4:30 so people can still make pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4:30 works for me — I can check with a couple of parents and see who can cover that window.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help get the repair drive moving—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Jules — I’ll repeat the plan to the others and let you know what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good, Vik — I’m here when you’ve got the list, and I can help fill any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring over whatever tools you need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — that helps a lot. I just want to make sure we’ve got the right tools and enough room to move everything around.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem — I can bring the toolbox and clear a bit of space so we’ve got room to work.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep an eye on the repair drive locations and note anything that changes. Just tell me where you want me to check first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — could you start with the east end of the block and the community bulletin board? If you spot anything new, just jot it down and let me know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll check the east end of the block and the community bulletin board, then report back with anything new.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana — are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — I think so, but let me double-check the time and what we’re bringing before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — what time works best, and should I bring tools or just donations?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you bring a flashlight, a roll of duct tape, and a screwdriver? If you can help sort the donated parts too, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring the flashlight, duct tape, and a screwdriver, and I can help sort the donated parts too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s coming together nicely—what’s the latest update?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think it’s going pretty well? I may have missed the newest details, but I can check and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks—I'm probably a step behind too. Just let me know when you’ve got the latest.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure the repair drive is still on for today?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, that’s what I heard — it’s still on for today. I’d swing by a little early just in case they’re already setting up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — can you confirm what time it starts?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, nice — how’s the repair drive going so far?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s going slowly, but people have been kind. I’m just trying to keep it moving one step at a time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds about right for these things—slow at first, but it adds up. I’m glad folks are being kind; anything you still need help with?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—I'm happy to help, I just need to remember what I signed up for again.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ve got you — I’ll check the sign-up list and send you your task.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Leo — appreciate it. Send it over when you can, and I’ll get on it.
